task.title: Filter at build time with DITAVAL
task.shortdesc: Remove content for every reader before it reaches the content store, for example staff-only notes, with a DITAVAL file named in opend.config.yaml.

stepxmp.codeblock: Ask in the team channel before changing this.

result.p: Excluded content is gone from the release snapshot, so no reader, preview or PDF can ever show it. This site keeps maintainer notes in internal/ this way.

ul.li: prop with an action of include, exclude, flag or passthrough. Only exclude removes content; the others keep it.
The most specific rule wins: attribute and value, then attribute only (no val), then a global default (no att), then include.
Flagging styles and revprop are ignored.
The root must be <val>, and an unknown action is an error (invalid-ditaval).

postreq.p: Any filtering attribute can be filtered at build time, but excluding a product, feature or release value here removes it for every reader. To gate readers, rely on their entitlements instead.
